test_title: PYST 53: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bags are cars.

All aeroplanes are cars.

**Conclusions:**

**(I)** Some bags are aeroplanes.

**(II)** Some cars are aeroplanes.
solution:
**Given Statements:**

All bags are cars.

All aeroplanes are cars.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df87f5ed21078cb028e24e13e659371663a89ff81008ca6a64d5777eeba13d48.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some bags are aeroplanes:**Does not follows** (Because, Bags are a subset of cars. Aeroplanes are also a subset of cars.There is no definite relation given between bags and aeroplanes.)

(II) Some cars are aeroplanes: **Follows** (Because, all aeroplanes are cars, which means at least some cars are aeroplanes.)

∴ Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
